maxHint: MAX keeps {fee} PPL for the network fee.
testTokenNote: Testnet token, not the real asset
impactWarn: Large trade for this pool: the price moves noticeably.
impactDanger: Very high price impact. This pool is small, so you get much less than the current price. Try a smaller amount.
slippageHint: If the price moves more than this before the swap is confirmed, it is cancelled and you keep your coins.
noFeeBalance: Not enough PPL for the network fee
wholePpl: This pool takes whole PPL only, for example 1 or 2.
smallPool: Small pool: even modest trades move the price.
addHint: Add both coins at the current pool price. Type one amount and the other fills in.
createHint: Pick a token you hold and set both amounts. Together they set the starting price.
wholePplCreate: Use a whole number of PPL for a new pool, for example 10. The network does not accept fractions here.
poolExists: This token already has a pool. Add liquidity to it above.
noTx: No transactions yet — make one in your wallet
notEnoughFee: Not enough PPL for the fee. Get test PPL in your wallet first.
tickerHint: 2–16 letters or digits, for example ROSC. People see it next to amounts.
decimalsHint: How finely one token can be split. 6 is the usual choice (the same as PPL). Keep it unless you need another value.
nftHint: One NFT is one unique item. You pay only the fee shown below.
feeHint: One-time fee in PPL, paid when you sign.
tokenIconHint: PNG, JPEG or WEBP, up to 1 MB, at least 64×64 px.
tokenIconErrType: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WEBP image.
tokenIconErrSize: The image must be 1 MB or smaller.
tokenIconErrDimensions: The image must be at least 64×64 px.
tokenIconErrRead: Could not read this image. Try another file.
tokenIconErrUpload: Could not upload the icon. Try again.
tokenMetadataErrPin: Could not save the token details to IPFS. Nothing was sent and no fee was charged. Try again.
tokenCreateSuccessLead: Your token is live on the PEOPLE testnet.
tokenDuplicateTitle: A token with this name and symbol already exists
tokenDuplicateLead: A token with the same name and symbol already exists:
tokenDuplicateInline: A token with this name and symbol already exists. Check the warning below.
